verdict.rationale: The evidence shows telli produces call transcripts that users can review and analyze. Nothing documents real-time transcription accuracy, a choice of STT provider, language or model selection, or key-term or custom-vocabulary boosting, which is the control this story requires. Transcript viewing on its own is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms
